title: Infinite Information Within Your Reach
s1title: The sky belongs to Haavk. The new world begins with you.
s1desc:
How can the paralyzed stand again,
the voiceless speak,
and the blind see the world?Can lost memories be recovered?
Can damaged brain cells be repaired?
Can broken patterns of thought be reconnected into something whole?Relink is turning the impossible into reality.
Relink gives technology a human pulse.
It rebuilds the way we connect with the world
— and reveals the true shape of tomorrow.
newtxt1:
The Relink Laboratory carries the vision of two generations of leading scientists.From Dr. Martin's foundational research to Dr. Rometheus's breakthrough concepts in Neural Device interfaces, Relink has continued to push beyond the limits of what the human brain can restore, rebuild, and become.We believe Neural Device technology is not merely a technical leap.
It is the liberation of human potential.The laboratory is dedicated to helping implant recipients regain access to sight, cognition, mobility, communication, and once-inaccessible medical resources at dramatically reduced cost. By narrowing the gap created by unequal access to advanced care, ReLink gives technology warmth, rebuilds the connection between humanity and the world, and opens a path toward a better future.
newtxt2: The Relink Laboratory is equipped with world-leading sterile surgical centers, micron-level implantation precision, real-time whole-brain signal monitoring platforms, and cross-modal rehabilitation facilities.For every breakthrough study, we provide complete support from advanced R&D to continuous patient care. With sufficient funding and a cross-disciplinary team of specialists, Relink accelerates the transformation of research into clinical application, laying a solid foundation for the medical adoption of Neural Device technology.
newtxt3:
The Relink Laboratory has independently developed and completed clinical trials for several Neural Device technologies now entering phased medical deployment worldwide, including:
-DeepPupil
-DeepBrain
-HyperSense
-Rainbow BridgeThese technologies include world-leading bidirectional visual-neural interfaces, reconstruction systems for motor and cognitive impairment, multi-band information fusion for cross-modal sensory expansion, direct brain-to-brain communication engineering, and seamless brain-AI bridging platforms.
s2txt2: Security Director Anais Desmoulins, Global Security Director of Haavk, lost her sight, suffered severe vocal damage, and sustained extensive facial trauma during a terrorist attack.Using Haavk Dynamics' most advanced ReLink Neural Device technology, her vision was restored, her vocal function was repaired, and her muscular coordination gradually recovered.
s2txt4: By deeply integrating advanced Neural Device interfaces with the SkyNet real-time data system, Haavk has enabled field operators to achieve rapid environmental awareness, precise decision-making, and accelerated response.In sudden regional incidents, emergency rescue operations, fire zones, radiation zones, and other high-risk environments, the system can significantly reduce reaction delay, optimize operational efficiency, and greatly improve operator self-defense capability and mission survival probability.
s2txt5: Layla, the Young Girl from Ahsarah
s2txt6: At Darrah Primary School in Ahsarah, there was once a child whose world had been stripped of color and muted by fate: Layla.Illness took away her sight and hearing. Poverty kept her far from medical care and even farther from the classroom.Through Dr. Rometheus's Neural Dawn Program, a non-invasive Neural Device interface was used to bypass Layla's damaged neural pathways, re-encode light and sound, and deliver them directly into her long-silent brain.
s2txt7: Layla, the Young Girl from Ahsarah
s2txt8: Layla's Neural Device also carried an intelligent education support system, capable of adjusting her learning rhythm in real time based on brainwave patterns and delivering knowledge in the form most easily absorbed by her mind.Once held back by disability, she is now focused and responsive in the classroom.More importantly, Haavk has provided this system free of charge to all impoverished children at Darrah Primary School in Ahsarah, allowing quality education resources to cross the boundaries of wealth and geography.
s3txt1: The first-generation Relink product was created for medical use, designed to help patients with neurodegenerative diseases or motor impairments restore bodily function.
s3txt2: The second-generation Relink product was created not only for patients, but also for ordinary individuals who choose implantation to enhance their physical capabilities.
